name: Arabic stickers
description_html:
yo everyone since @7bpencil creating a beautiful mod called: Weapon Camo And Stickers where you can add camo and stickers on your weapon i thought of making some stickers in arabic words (dont worry there will be no bad words in the future) i add 4 sentence and numbers from 0 to 9 for a start and that is:

  • go and my heart prayer for you
  • miss you habibi
  • life is hard
  • this is my rifle
  • you will remember me when you lost me
  • numbers examples in this link: https://imgur.com/a/FWXlr7K

if you guys love it i will make more and you can even send me in DM on my discord CMDR_Tank also if you want me to write it i will be happy to do it so dont be shy ;)

anyways enjoy and thank you so much 7bpencil for your beautiful mod you create
